title: StoneDimensions
description: The real, resolved dimension contract every Stone System module (geometry construction, Forge validation) actually consumes — documents backend/jewelmind/domain/stone_dimensions.py's resolved_length_mm()/resolved_width_mm()/resolved_depth_mm() output, not the raw JDL 'stone' object (which differs by shape — see stone-definition.schema.json). For round, resolvedLengthMm == resolvedWidthMm == diameter (STONE-GOV-005: shape and dimensions are separate concepts). See docs/bible/20-stone/564-stone-dimension-model.md.

resolvedLengthMm.description: Major horizontal dimension (local Y axis at orientation=0 — the same axis the band revolves around). See docs/bible/20-stone/565-stone-coordinate-and-orientation.md.

resolvedWidthMm.description: Minor horizontal dimension (local X axis at orientation=0).

resolvedDepthMm.description: Vertical dimension (local Z axis) — identical field (stone.depth) for every shape.
